youtube.title: 坐車看書就暈到想吐？其實會暈反而代表內耳超健康｜原來如此事務所
youtube.description:
同一台車走同一條山路，為什麼在後座看書就頭暈想吐，前面開車的司機卻一點事都沒有？更奇怪的是，蒙住眼睛坐車照樣暈，坐在沙發上一動不動看賽車遊戲也會暈！
原來會暈車根本不是內耳不好——前庭平衡功能完全不能用的人才徹底免疫！用「一杯水」一次看懂內耳液體與耳石、感覺衝突與大腦預測模型、3,256 名遊覽車乘客 3 倍視野差、司機控制權實驗、VR 視覺暈動症與火車錯覺、10,000 倍個體差異，以及至今仍未定案的毒物假說與衝突神經元！

📚 參考研究與官方出處：
- CDC Yellow Book 2026 (Motion Sickness)：https://www.cdc.gov/yellow-book/hcp/travel-air-sea/motion-sickness.html
- NIDCD (NIH) Balance Disorders：https://www.nidcd.nih.gov/health/balance-disorders
- Lackner JR (2014) Exp Brain Res (10,000:1 vulnerability & vestibular immunity)：https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4112051/
- Griffin & Newman (2004) Visual field effects & live video in cars：https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15460624/
- Turner & Griffin (1999) 3,256 coach travellers：https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10048305/
- Kuiper et al. (2018, 2020) Windshield display & auditory cues：https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29409631/
- Rolnick & Lubow (1991) Why is the driver rarely motion sick?：https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1915252/
- Keshavarz et al. (2015) Vection & VIMS：https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4403286/
- Dong et al. (2011) Virtual vehicle control：https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21604911/
- Oman & Cullen (2014) Brainstem conflict neurons：https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24838552/

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 所長！坐車看書就暈到想吐，前面開車的司機卻完全沒事，難道是我內耳不健康嗎？

data.prompt: Wide shot scenic sunlit Taiwanese mountain winding road overlooking forested hills, a charming compact pastel-blue car curving smoothly uphill along a twisting bend.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 剛好相反——會暈反而代表內耳很健康！不過內耳同樣正常，每個人的敏感度竟能差一萬倍，後面再揭曉為什麼！

data.prompt: Close-up split tabletop diorama: left half shows a tiny blindfolded wooden figurine seated in a tilting toy car seat; right half shows a figurine sitting still on a living-room sofa facing a glowing racing track screen.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 更怪的是，蒙住眼睛坐車竟然照樣暈，甚至坐在沙發上一動不動看賽車畫面，一樣有人暈到反胃。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling intriguingly behind her oak table beside a clear glass cup of gently tilted blue-tinted water.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這些怪現象背後，其實是你的大腦在跟眼睛、耳朵對帳時，當場抓到了天大的破綻。

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit car center-console cup holder holding a clear tumbler of crystal water sloshing sharply sideways as warm sunlight flashes across the rippling surface.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 今天我們就來聊聊，坐車看書為什麼特別容易暈，又為什麼開車的人幾乎免疫。

scenes.chapter: 會暈反而代表你的平衡系統超健康？

data.prompt: Medium shot in the car backseat with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, pointing curiously toward her ear with one five-fingered hand while holding the red-cover book in her lap.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 等等！大家常說會暈車是「內耳平衡不好」，怎麼會反過來代表我的內耳很健康？

data.prompt: Close-up wordless comparison on a sunlit wooden surface: a glowing golden gyroscope spinning sharply beside a lively rippling water glass on left, contrasted with a motionless unlit brass ring beside a still glass on right.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 研究暈車的人發現，只有內耳平衡功能完全不能用的人才徹底免疫；內耳正常的人，幾乎每一個都可能暈。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, nodding warmly and holding up a clear glass of water catching golden rim light in one five-fingered hand.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 所以換個角度說，你會暈車，恰恰代表耳朵裡這套平衡系統正在非常認真地工作！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit macro inside a moving car cabin: a clear glass cup of sparkling water sitting in a dark cup holder tilting noticeably to one side as bright golden sunbeams sparkle on tiny suspended crystalline grains inside.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 想像車上放一杯水，車一動水面就會晃；耳朵深處就有類似裝置——裝著液體的小管子，跟帶微小顆粒的小袋子。

data.prompt: Close-up side-by-side tabletop visual: left clear water glass swirling in a crisp circular vortex; right clear water glass sloshing forward sharply like sudden braking, glowing soft cyan highlights.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 車子一轉彎，小管子裡的液體就晃；一加速煞車，小袋子裡被重力往下拉的顆粒也跟著偏——大腦靠它們知道你怎麼動。

data.prompt: Wide shot sunny neighborhood sidewalk diorama: a pair of yellow sneakers stepping forward carrying a clear glass cup of rippling water while leafy trees scroll smoothly backward along the bright street.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 不只內耳，眼睛看外面風景怎麼退、腳底跟肌肉都會同步報信；走路時大家說的一致，大腦就放心。

data.prompt: Close-up point-of-view inside a curving car cabin: a plain red-cover book held steady in front of the viewer while bright sunlit mountain trees blur rapidly past the side window behind it.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 但你坐後座低頭看書時，書本跟著你一起移動，對眼睛來說畫面其實靜止不動，於是回報大腦「沒在動」！

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic split tabletop comparison: left half shows a steady stationary red-cover book under a calm pale glow; right half shows a clear glass cup of water sloshing wildly with bright coral ripples.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 同一秒，耳朵裡那杯水卻隨著山路猛烈晃動，大喊「我們在急轉彎」——兩份報告當場對不上！

scenes.chapter: 閉眼竟照樣暈！關鍵不是吵架，是大腦猜錯

data.prompt: Medium shot in the car backseat with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, cheerfully slipping a soft navy fabric sleep mask halfway down toward her forehead with both five-fingered hands.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 如果只是眼耳對不上，把眼閉上不看書不就不吵了？那開頭怎麼說蒙眼坐車竟然照樣暈？

data.prompt: Wide shot sunlit British suburban road miniature: a sleek silver test sedan winding cleanly through leafy residential turns while a soft fabric sleep mask floats beside an opaque side curtain.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 英國團隊坐車三十分鐘實測，分看前路、遮住前路跟蒙眼三組——結果蒙眼跟遮住前路一樣暈，都比看前路難受得多！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, leaning forward thoughtfully gesturing with one five-fingered palm toward a translucent glowing compass dial.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 大家常說的「感覺衝突」，其實比的不是眼跟耳，而是大腦預測跟實際感覺：閉眼沒料到彎道，照樣對不上！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the car with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, peering sideways out the bright car side window with a hopeful clever grin.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 喔！那如果我看不到正前方，改盯旁邊側窗，或者照大家說的換坐前排總行了吧？

data.prompt: Close-up split interior view from a car backseat: left side window shows dizzying blurred green trees flashing sideways; center front windshield reveals a crisp calm curving mountain road and bright horizon ahead.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 小客車實測發現：只看側窗一樣暈；視野一樣時坐哪排其實沒差——前排舒服不是位置不晃，只因看清前路！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the bright office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling knowingly while holding a clear cup of calm water gently tilted along a curved wooden track prop.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 因為盯側窗只看到樹影刷過去、看不到彎道；只有看正前方，山路一拐彎，大腦才來得及預告耳朵裡那杯水往哪晃！

data.prompt: Wide shot sunlit highway diorama featuring a sleek touring coach bus: rear passenger rows sit behind tall opaque headrests glowing warm coral while the winding green highway stretches clearly through the panoramic windshield.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 英國問卷調查三千多位遊覽車乘客：看不到前路約三成五不舒服，看清前路卻僅約一成三——差快三倍！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the car backseat with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, leaning forward slightly peeking curiously between two empty front headrests toward the steering wheel ahead.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 看清前路竟然差了快三倍！那前面開車的司機呢，怎麼好像從來沒聽過司機喊暈車？

data.prompt: Wide shot sunlit psychology lab diorama: two identical minimalist wooden swivel chairs linked mechanically by a gleaming brass drive rod—left chair has a bright golden control handle glowing calm mint, right passive chair glows dizzy coral swirls.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 以色列團隊曾把二十二對受試者放進會轉的機器，每對轉法一模一樣，只讓其中一人自己控制方向。

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic split lab visual: left golden spinning top rotating smoothly in crisp emerald balance arcs; right identical spinning top wobbling amidst tangled swirling coral rings.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 結果能自己控制的那位，不舒服的症狀明顯少很多——明明兩人承受的旋轉動作完全相同！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit wooden tabletop metaphor: an adult hand gently turning a smooth wooden steering ring while a clear water cup's sloshing wave perfectly aligns inside a glowing mint prediction arc.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 研究者認為，主動操控時大腦早算好下一步；換成司機轉方向盤也一樣，動作一出去，耳朵裡那杯水晃得剛好全中預測！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, cupping one five-fingered hand near her mouth like cheerfully calling out a turn warning.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 那乘客不能握方向盤，如果像爸爸轉彎前先喊一聲「要轉彎囉」，用聲音幫大腦提前猜呢？

data.prompt: Wide shot sunlit laboratory rail-track diorama: a sleek compact testing sled gliding smoothly along a straight metal rail while gentle golden sound-wave chimes pulse softly just ahead of the next motion.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 還真有人測過！在軌道滑車實驗裡，用聲音先提醒下一步往哪動，受試者確實比較不暈——只是那是實驗滑車，還不是真山路。

scenes.chapter: 身體沒動也會暈？電影院和遊戲裡的反轉陷阱

data.prompt: Medium shot in a cozy sunlit living room with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, sitting cross-legged on a soft blue sofa staring wide-eyed toward a glowing off-screen TV while holding a plain game controller with five clean fingers.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 提前猜到動作真的有用！那你開頭說坐在沙發上一動不動、只看賽車畫面也會暈，又是怎麼回事？

data.prompt: Wide shot warm living room scene: a wide vibrant TV screen flashing a dramatic curving mountain race track, while right in front on the wooden coffee table sits a clear glass cup of water whose surface is completely dead flat and mirror still.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 同樣對不上帳，方向跟看書剛好相反！耳朵裡的水一動不動，眼睛卻大喊狂飆，這叫「視覺引起的暈動症」。

data.prompt: Close-up clean wooden shelf triptych: a miniature glowing movie theater screen, a sleek white VR headset resting calmly, and a tiny cockpit flight simulator horizon dial glowing warm amber.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 從電影院超大銀幕、虛擬實境頭盔、駕駛模擬器到電玩遊戲，只要畫面充滿視野，都有人遇過這種暈眩。

data.prompt: Wide shot nostalgic Taiwanese railway platform bathed in golden afternoon sun: viewing from inside a parked commuter train window as the sleek silver train on the adjacent track smoothly glides forward past the glass.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 就像停在月台的火車，旁邊那列一開走，你會瞬間覺得是自己這列在動——這種「自我移動錯覺」常跟它一起出現！

data.prompt: Close-up side-by-side split on a warm wooden surface: left glowing game controller actively steering a bright racing track under calm mint light; right identical track replay playing passively beside folded hands under swirling coral rings.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 前面司機的「主動操控」搬到螢幕也管用：兩人配對看同段賽車畫面，自己握搖桿開的人明顯比較少喊暈！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, eyes lighting up eagerly as she raises one five-fingered hand in a bright eureka gesture.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 我想到了！既然前面說看前路能讓大腦預告彎道，那在車上後座椅背裝一台螢幕即時播前方的路，不就解決了嗎？

data.prompt: Close-up inside a moving car backseat: a tablet mounted on the headrest displaying a live video feed of the winding road ahead, yet dizzy swirling coral ripples still rise around the tablet frame.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 英國團隊真的實測過這招——結果超打臉！後座螢幕即時播前路完全沒比較不暈，光靠螢幕畫面還少了真實空間感。

data.prompt: Close-up car dashboard cutaway: comparing a plain sleek tablet mounted high at eye level against the bright front windshield showing the road around it (glowing calm mint) vs the same tablet mounted low by the dark glovebox (glowing muted orange).

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 荷蘭另一項實驗也印證這點：同樣在車上看螢幕找東西，得架高到前窗旁讓眼角看到真實外景，才比放低處明顯不暈！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio shelf holding three translucent framed miniature scenes—a curving windshield road, a pixelated video monitor, and a tilted horizon—linked by delicate glowing amber question threads.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 研究者因此坦言，到底哪些畫面會讓人暈、哪些畫面能壓住暈眩，科學界到現在還沒完全弄懂。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the bright office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, holding up both open five-fingered palms gently with a candid, intriguing smile.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這正是「感覺衝突」的界線：它指出哪裡對不上，卻還解不開兩大謎團——體質差一萬倍，還有為何偏想吐！

scenes.chapter: 最會暈和最不會暈差一萬倍，為何偏偏想吐？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, leaning over the oak counter with wide curious eyes holding both five-fingered hands wide apart in astonishment.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 對耶！開頭說最會暈跟最不會暈敏感度差一萬倍——先說第一個，同坐後座為何有人沒事、有人十分鐘就投降？

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 先看年齡落差：兩歲以下通常不太會暈，之後越來越容易，七到十二歲衝上高峰，長大後再慢慢變少。

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit wooden display showing two stylized glowing glass bar columns: a towering amber age-curve arch beside a much smaller gentle lilac pair of silhouettes and a pulsing violet forehead-ripple charm.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 女生確實比男生容易暈一點，但性別差距比年紀小得多；另外常偏頭痛的人，也明顯比較容易暈。

data.prompt: Close-up warm sunlit studio floor: two identical pairs of bright yellow canvas sneakers placed neatly side by side on honey-oak planks beside a stack of worn vintage bus tickets.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 雙胞胎研究還發現，容易暈車很大一部分跟遺傳有關；遊覽車調查也看到，越常坐車的人越少暈。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, counting clues on her five clean fingers with wide surprised eyes.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 既然找到這麼多線索，那為什麼同一家親兄妹一起坐後座，還是常有人完全沒事、有人一下子就投降？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, tilting her head thoughtfully with one five-fingered hand resting near her chin.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這正是目前科學界的空白：把這些線索全攤開後，決定每個人體質差距的真正原因，到現在仍沒完全搞清楚。

data.prompt: Medium close-up inside the sunny office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, clutching her tummy lightly with one five-fingered hand and raising the other hand in genuine puzzlement.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 那第二個謎團呢？預測跟感覺對不上，大腦直接頭昏就好啦，為什麼偏偏要讓人「想吐」？

data.prompt: Close-up storybook tabletop diorama: a tilted swirling clear glass of water resting beside a glowing spotted purple fairytale toadstool mushroom inside a frosted glass cloche, casting questioning golden shadows.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這個「為什麼」到今天還沒定案！一九七七年有學者提出「毒物假說」，猜大腦把感官錯亂誤認成吃進神經毒物。

data.prompt: Close-up daylight-grey tabletop: a brass balance scale tilting uncertainly with glowing emerald pebbles on the left pan and coral pebbles on the right pan, neither side winning completely.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 照這猜法，身體是想把假想毒物排出去才啟動嘔吐；雖然常被引用，但也有證據對不上，所以至今只能算假說。

data.prompt: Wide shot bright surreal tabletop miniature room: a small wooden figurine standing upright on a flat floor while the striped wooden walls around it gently sway sideways, faint ripple waves pulsing beneath the figurine's feet.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 還有派「姿勢不穩假說」猜想吐跟身體穩不穩有關，確實有實驗在受試者喊不舒服前，先拍到身體明顯多晃。

data.prompt: Close-up luminous anatomical cutaway metaphor: two contrasting glowing neural light clusters inside a translucent sapphire dome—passive-motion cluster flaring bright electric orange while self-driven cluster stays serenely calm emerald.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 不過神經科學倒有了關鍵線索：研究者在腦幹附近找到一群特別的腦細胞，對主動跟被動晃動反應完全不同！

data.prompt: Close-up glowing crystal wave chart on dark slate blue: left jagged blazing amber pulse wave for passive external tilt; right flat serene emerald calm line for self-steered motion.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 被別人帶著動時這群細胞反應極大，自己動時卻很安靜——研究者猜，這可能就是大腦比對實際和預期的地方。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling thoughtfully while gesturing gently toward a luminous glowing question-gap between two small crystal orbs.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 但這群細胞的訊號怎麼連到想吐的開關，最後這段還沒找到——不過前面這些線索，已經夠回答你開頭的困惑了！

scenes.chapter: 原來會暈，是大腦算得太認真了

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit car backseat now arriving near bright green countryside hills with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, setting the red-cover comic down and beaming with a huge joyful eureka smile.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 原來如此！還記得開頭坐車看書暈到想吐、司機卻沒事嗎？看來關鍵就是大腦能不能提早猜對下一步！

data.prompt: Medium shot outside a sunny countryside red-brick courtyard house with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, stepping out refreshed and smiling brightly giving a cheerful five-fingered thumbs-up.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 以後我在車上頭一開始發昏，再也不會怪自己內耳太弱了——它根本比誰都還要認真上班嘛！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the warm golden-hour wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling warmly behind her oak counter holding the clear glass of still sunlit water.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 說得太棒了！我覺得最有趣的是，我們的平衡系統練了幾百萬年只熟走路，坐上現代交通工具才會突然對不上帳。

data.prompt: Close-up cozy golden-hour wooden porch table outside a red-brick Taiwanese courtyard house: a plain red-cover comic resting calmly beside a clear glass of cool still water catching warm amber afternoon sunbeams.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 下次在山路、火車月台或遊戲畫面裡突然感到一陣微晃，你就能一眼認出，是哪兩份報告又沒跟大腦對齊！
